capabilities: Hide the folder path in un-aliased internal link labels in reading view and live preview
Reveal the full link path on the cursor's line for editing
Color internal links like plain text instead of the accent color
Rank notes from priority folders at the top of the [[ autocomplete
Leave aliased links, embeds, and heading/block references untouched
disambiguation: Not a link manager or checker; it only changes how link labels display and, optionally, how the [[ suggester ranks results.
extras: The smart suggester reorders an undocumented Obsidian internal editor-suggest API, which the README says is accessed defensively and reverted when the feature is off or the plugin unloads.
intentEvidence: replace Obsidian's built-in [[ popup for the plain case
problem: Obsidian shows the full folder path in internal links like [[Personal/SurfacerAI]], which clutters note text even though only the file name matters for navigation.
summary: Link display tweak that hides folder paths in internal links so only the file name shows, plus an optional suggester that ranks priority-folder notes first.
